_comment: MACF Scrum configuration — Jesse (Oct 10, 2026). Follows Alistair Cockburn's Crystal Clear methodology.

cockburn_principles.expert_user_access: Jesse is the product owner; all demos relay to him for approval (demoRelay.js)
cockburn_principles.focus: Sprint goals limited to 3 priorities max; WIP limits enforced
cockburn_principles.frequent_delivery: Every 12h sprint must produce verifiable deliverables (Jesse's law: no link, not a demo)
cockburn_principles.osmotic_communication: All standups and sprint events post in #management for team-wide visibility
cockburn_principles.personal_safety: Agents report blockers honestly without penalty; blockers are system defects to fix, not blame
cockburn_principles.reflective_improvement: Each sprint retro feeds the improvement loop (engine/improvementLoop.js)
cockburn_principles.technical_environment: TDD/BDD required; automated tests gate every sprint deliverable

questions: What did you accomplish in the last hour?
What are you planning for the next hour?

definition_of_done.demo_link_works: Demo artifact has a working clickable link

suggest_split_techniques: Split by acceptance criteria (each criterion = separate story)
Split by happy path vs edge cases
Spike first: research story (0 points) then split
